**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 3 (every old goal is read), batches 1 to 9 are done.** `docs/agent/goal-decisions.md` names every goal on the chain from `core-depth` to `core-test-1-2` (`data/chain.json:155`), in `## Decisions` or the closing `## Goals with nothing to keep` list. Stage 3's check stays red until every goal in front of `goal-closeout` is named there. The remaining 32 goals are batch 10 (`core-test-2-2` to `core-zip`) and batch 11 (`tools-cli` to `ci-green`).

The goals from `core-math-1-3` on have one dossier stage, only `bun nv proofs` checks of their own, and a handoff whose `backlog` is what needs checking. A `bun -e` one-liner over `data/goals/<slug>.handoff.json` prints the backlogs of a batch faster than a subagent. `bun nv proofs --owed` owes nothing. The guard denies a `grep` over `data/goals/*.json`, and a `bun -e` read is the way round it for a goal that is not live.

Gaps owned by `goal-closeout`, and opened by this stage, all under `data/gaps/`: `nv/no-suite-runs-the-proof-programs-once-the-floor-is-gone`, `nv/tool-surfaces-checked-only-by-the-floor`, `nv/the-tsan-check-s-crate-keying-has-no-test`, `nv/data-schema-is-promised-and-nothing-writes-it`, `website/the-website-grammar-is-hand-written-beside-the-editors`, `nvs-stdlib/reference-cards-are-not-held-to-the-plain-voice`, `nvs-stdlib/csv-parse-refuses-a-tainted-document`, `nvs-stdlib/core-server-has-no-request-environment-or-trace-id`, `benches/member-benches-index-with-a-uint`. Stage 4 sorts them into done and too large.

`bun nv import` is broken, because the rule index it reads was deleted. Goal `ci-green`'s floor check stays red until Stage 6. That is expected.
